explication: Web-Check is an on-demand website intelligence scanner: a user supplies a target, the UI presents check results, and the backend exposes individual checks as API routes. Its documented coverage spans security, SEO, server, domain, email, and performance; the checks catalog and client analysis rules help organize and interpret that breadth. The excerpts show server route registration, shared request validation, and selected API behavior, but not the full scan orchestration or most check implementations, so those links are kept broad or omitted.
